title: Distinguish check, inspection and exploration
when: When the expected outcome requires assertions, visual judgment or exploratory observation.
need: Command/CI and Browser check use automatic results; Browser inspection captures evidence for agent judgment. Pack-added methods and exploratory missions have additional contracts. A screenshot is not a pass. Exploratory missions use informed_subagent from the controller; fresh targets stay free of a source checkout. Unsupported executors require a saved-case correction and rematerialization.
surface: Method definitions; Browser reference; exploratory QA dispatch
gap: Review question: should verification planning offer the relevant method in plain language and fetch its reference only after selection?
